title: AWS scalers: `identityOwner` is deprecated as of 2.13 — removal announced for KEDA v3

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned; apache-kafka, prometheus (AWS SigV4) and, from 2.14, kafka read it through the same GetAwsAuthorization

quote: `identityOwner` - Receive permissions on the SQS Queue via Pod Identity or from the KEDA operator itself (see below). (DEPRECATED: This parameter is deprecated as of KEDA v2.13 and will be removed in version `3`, Values: `pod`, `operator`, Default: `pod`, Optional, This field only applies for `aws-eks` authentication)
remediation: Docs-only deprecation (no CHANGELOG entry). `identityOwner: operator|pod` only applies to the `aws-eks` / `aws-kiam` pod identities; with `podIdentity.provider: aws` the TriggerAuthentication's `identityOwner` decides. Each trigger named keeps working through 2.x; drop the key when its authentication moves to `aws`.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select((.type | test("^(aws-|apache-kafka$|kafka$|prometheus$)")) and (.metadata // {} | has("identityOwner"))) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type) identityOwner=\(.metadata.identityOwner)"'  # each row carries the trigger-level key the docs deprecate

title: `podIdentity.provider: azure` (AAD Pod Identity) and `aws-kiam` are removed
quote: **Authentication:** AAD-Pod-Identity and AWS-KIAM auths have been removed (#5035|#5085)
remediation: Every TriggerAuthentication / ClusterTriggerAuthentication named stops authenticating after the hop: the 2.15 CRDs drop `azure` and `aws-kiam` from the `podIdentity.provider` enum — at the top level AND inside the `azureKeyVault`, `awsSecretManager` and `gcpSecretManager` blocks — so the object is invalid under the new schema and the operator cannot build its scalers. Switch to `azure-workload` (Azure AD Workload Identity) or `aws` (IRSA / EKS Pod Identity) and re-point the identity annotations before upgrading. Stored objects are not re-validated on read: the scaler fails because the provider code is gone, and the narrowed CRD enum (every podIdentity.provider path) rejects any UPDATE that keeps the old value.
verifyCommand: kubectl get triggerauthentications.keda.sh,clustertriggerauthentications.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select([.. | objects | .podIdentity? // empty | .provider] | any(. == "azure" or . == "aws-kiam")) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name) providers=\([.. | objects | .podIdentity? // empty | .provider] | unique | join(","))"'  # each row uses a provider the 2.15 CRD no longer accepts

title: Prometheus: the `cortexOrgID` field is removed from the scaler

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned

quote: **Prometheus Scaler**: Remove deprecated field `cortexOrgID` from Prometheus scaler (#5538)
remediation: 2.15 deletes the field and the error branch that refused it since 2.10; from here the key is silently ignored. Any prometheus trigger still carrying `cortexOrgID` has not scaled since 2.10 — replace it with `customHeaders: X-Scope-OrgID=<tenant>`.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select((.type == "prometheus") and (.metadata // {} | has("cortexOrgID"))) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row still carries the removed key
